Scoring_point_3_Problem_1.answer: The hotel bill includes 7 nights (14 Oct – 20 Oct, check‑out on 21 Oct), but according to the work plan and approval form, only 5 nights (14 Oct – 18 Oct) were approved. The room charges for 19 Oct and 20 Oct were incurred after the scheduled end date (19 October). These extra nights are not reimbursable.

Scoring_point_4_Problem_2.answer: For the 5 approved nights, the per‑night charge in each case exceeds the guest accommodation cap of $250 per night for a Tier‑3 North American city. The maximum reimbursable amount for the approved nights is therefore $1,250 (5 nights × $250).
